scripts.build: pnpm --filter @j-boardman/convex-vue run build && pnpm --filter @j-boardman/convex-nuxt run build
scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:prepare && pnpm --parallel --stream --filter @j-boardman/convex-playground-backend --filter @j-boardman/convex-vue-playground --filter @j-boardman/convex-nuxt-playground run dev
scripts.dev:prepare: pnpm --filter @j-boardman/convex-vue run build && pnpm --filter @j-boardman/convex-nuxt exec nuxt-module-build prepare && pnpm --filter @j-boardman/convex-playground-backend run codegen
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:module && pnpm run test:package
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:packages && pnpm run test:types
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
